subject: Saturday open studio?
text:
Hey there,

Quick heads-up: the little open-studio gathering we floated last week is now on for Saturday at four. Bring snacks if you can, and maybe a folding chair. I had to splurge on a last-minute projector rental after my laptop gave me the silent treatment, so I'm feeling a tad poor. Should still be low-key and fun though. No need to RSVP; I'll just wing the seating.

Catch you then?
